purpose: Teach: 茶碗/はさみ/出掛ける/短冊/さくらんぼ/あゆ/前歯/ヤリ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科で、本気で、絶対、お茶碗、絶対、洗う、絶対、コツ、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Hey Riku — remember that trick for washing rice bowls from home-ec? The one we actually paid attention to?
lines.style: Quick, teasing energy. Bright opener on the question. Slight conspiratorial lean on 'actually paid attention.' Testing him a little, but warm underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。工作の、本気で、絶対、はさみ、絶対、忘れちゃったぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, yeah — and I totally forgot my scissors in crafts. No excuse, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware laugh in the middle. Casual deflection. Unflustered admission. The wry half-smile of someone caught in a small thing and not bothered by it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今度、本気for、絶対、お前と、絶対、お祭りに、絶対、出掛ける、絶対、よ、リク
lines.en: Next time we should go to the festival together. Seriously.
lines.style: Lighter tone than before, almost gentle. 'Next time' opens with quiet intention. Small pause after 'together' — letting him know she means it, not just saying it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 七夕の、本気で、絶対、短冊、絶対、お前、絶対、何書いた?桜
lines.en: What did you write on your Tanabata wish? Your tanzaku, I mean.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, softer. The question lands with real interest — not performative. Slight self-correction on 'tanzaku' like she wants to get it right for him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、さくらんぼ、絶対、もらったよ、リク
lines.en: Grandma gave me these cherries, remember? They were so good.
lines.style: Warm, slightly animated recollection. 'Grandma gave me' lands with affection. Trails slightly on 'so good' — a small moment of contentment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 川で、本気で、絶対、あゆ、絶対、釣り、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、行ったぜ、桜
lines.en: I went fishing for ayu down at the river with Dad. Caught some too.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Even pacing, steady. Not bragging — just stating a fact he's genuinely proud of. Slight warmth on the memory of being there with his father.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、前歯、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、欠けてるよ、リク
lines.en: Your front tooth — it's still a little chipped, by the way.
lines.style: Light, observational teasing. Almost casual. Not unkind — the tone of someone noticing something and pointing it out because they actually pay attention to him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活で、本気for、絶対、ヤリ、絶対、投げ、絶対、選手、絶対、すごいよな、桜
lines.en: That javelin thrower on the team is incredible, right? Really something.
lines.style: Admiring, measured respect. Slower pace. Not gushing — just genuine acknowledgment of something impressive. Small nod of respect in the voice.
